title: BLACKBOX.md lives at ~/.blackbox/, not ~/.claude-shared/; opencode wired via instructions config field
content:
**BLACKBOX.md lives at `~/.blackbox/BLACKBOX.md`, never `~/.claude-shared/`**

Provider-neutral global memory file (the file `bbox_render scope=global` produces with the agentic opening sequence + tool reference + standing orders) lives under `~/.blackbox/`. The historical location `~/.claude-shared/BLACKBOX.md` is wrong: `.claude-shared` is claude-specific multi-account state, and putting a provider-neutral file there meant opencode/glm/deepseek bros never looked at it (opencode's global-file lookup is `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` + `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, never `.claude-shared`).

- Path resolver: `crate::util::blackbox_global_common_md_path` in `src/util.rs` returns `~/.blackbox/BLACKBOX.md` (env override `BLACKBOX_GLOBAL_COMMON_MD`).
- `src/render.rs::global_common_target_path` delegates to it.
- `migrate_legacy_defaults` in `src/util.rs` moves any leftover `~/.claude-shared/BLACKBOX.md` → new path on daemon start, leaves a back-compat symlink at the old path so existing `@imports` in user-authored memory files keep resolving.
- OpenCode's generated config (`build_opencode_config` in `src/orchestration/brofile.rs`) lists the file in its `instructions` config field — opencode does NOT follow Claude's `@import` syntax, so the file gets merged into the system prompt with header `Instructions from: <path>`. Verified: a glm-4.5-air probe with the field set quotes "CORE RULE: agentic opening sequence" verbatim from BLACKBOX.md.

Provider memory files (`~/.claude-shared/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.codex/AGENTS.md`, `~/.gemini/GEMINI.md`) `@import` the new path. Future renders and migrations should keep the file at this location.

Tags: blackbox-md, render, opencode-instructions, provider-neutral-memory, .blackbox-dir, 2026-05-06
